tasks.answer: order-service 500s began at 12:12:31Z (first error log), with the metric bucket jumping at 12:10–12:20 from a ~0.2% baseline to 14.74% and holding ~18-20% through 13:59Z. The error signature is a java.lang.NullPointerException 'marginProfile is null' at MarginCheckValidator.validate line 88, returned as HTTP 500, and appears exclusively on orderType=FNO (derivatives) orders; order-service p99 latency stayed flat (~150ms). api-gateway shows a smaller parallel error rise (~3.4% vs ~0.2% baseline) consistent with propagation. A deployment dep-5101 (v2.14.0) completed at 12:10:08Z, ~2.4 minutes before the first error.
